bundle.shortDescription: AEGIS Desktop — on-device DICOM de-identification + upload
bundle.longDescription: Native desktop client for the Anonymization & Exchange Gateway for Imaging Studies (AEGIS). Performs tag, pixel, and (where applicable) face de-identification entirely on your machine before uploading the cleaned study to your AEGIS project. Includes a 'watch folder' mode that auto-uploads new studies as they appear on disk.
